meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的观察历史构建出一个个专注的知识库(corpus),把相关记录加载进对话,然后让你用自然语言提问并得到回答。它还能列出、更新或重置这些知识库。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史创建专注的“大脑”、询问过去的工作模式、或整理特定主题的经验时触发。

say.text: 用我的观察记录建一个关于 hooks 的知识库,limit 100
say.note: 会构建名为 hooks 的知识库

say.text: 查询 hooks 知识库:有哪些生命周期钩子?

say.note: 显示全部语料库和状态

howto.what_en: Claude builds focused knowledge bases (corpora) from your observation history, loads them into a conversational session, and answers natural-language questions about them. It can also list, rebuild, or reset these corpora.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create a focused "brain" from observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a hooks knowledge base from my observations, limit 100
Query the hooks knowledge base: what lifecycle hooks exist?
say_en.note: Primes and answers from the corpus
